postconditions.description: The sequence a has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10^9 for a_i in a)
postconditions.description: Each element a_i in the sequence a is a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(sum((k + 2) * a_((i + k) % n + 1) for k in range(n)) == b_i for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The total duration of concerts in each city matches the given b_i for all test cases.

invariants.description: The number of cities n is between 1 and 40,000.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10^9 for b_i in b)
invariants.description: Each total duration b_i in the list b is a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.
The sum of the number of cities n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.
